_rule: Prepared BEFORE the run (AGENTS.md). STAGED, not queued, not authorized: needs a user go for this batch.
profile: data/release.ini + launcher preset through common/settings.h (release_qual/profile.cpp), dev=0; qualification-only overrides are log periods, detailed_logging and the one float export per static phase
observable: The release profile of 0.9.6 (Ultra and High at Water Queens House, Ultra in Dialogue1) runs every measured window without a fault after the changes of 2026-11-14/15: scene handout default, VRAM policies, hair fixes with RTX Hair Off.
pass_rule: Every gate of the 2026-11-04 final qualification (water traced and composed, finite, driver-budget VRAM, 0 RT capture drops, 0 alpha region overflow, cascade buffer full 0, scene wait 0 timeouts, current TLAS, RR/post/GI cost lines, OMM same-ray check on High, native hair and scalp records in the dialogue, one master OFF/ON cycle) plus, in the five S8 cost windows of each preset: every first RT query handed out, handout fallbacks 0, pairing mismatches 0, OMM downgraded 0, hit-material fallbacks 0. No crash, device loss or strand producer. These are counts of real faults: 0, no tolerance.

predicted_today.scene wait S8 (High and Ultra, handout O: mean about 0.3 ms (0.28 in hq-s8-modes 205520; 3.5 without); 0 timeouts; reported, the gate is the fault counts (docs/SCENE_HANDOUT_DESIGN.md 8.7)
predicted_today.handout: 0 fallbacks, 0 pairing mismatches in every cost window (8.5 to 8.8)
predicted_today.VRAM policies: RT capture first buffer 1024 MB, cascade 3 x 427 MB, 0 dropped draws, guard quiet (hx1 001645, docs/HANDOFF_SESSION.md); VRAM used about 0.8 GB below the 2026-11-04 receipts at S8; reported
predicted_today.hair: stock cards: no [hair primary] or [hair groom] activity line in any window
predicted_today.GPU ms: RT, GI, RR and post within the rel1/rel2/rel3 observed ranges; GI trace may read 0.2-0.4 ms lower with the handout (seen in one rerun, EXPLAIN): report it, do not count it as a gain
predicted_today.energy: one float pre-post export per profile, reported; no same-profile baseline exists, so no energy pass or fail

not_judged: frame time and presented captures (the window may be occluded); GPU ms deltas against the 2026-11-04 references are descriptive (release_qual/predicted_final.json); card or strand counts.
if_it_fails: A handout fallback or mismatch in a steady window: report the reason counts of the line; the release decision is Low-latency scene Off in the presets (one choice index per preset). A dropped opaque draw: report the capture line; the decision is rt_capture_demand_size or rt_capture_peak_reserve off.
human_review: Dialogue PNG: stock cards visible, face and neck shadows. S8 PNGs: cutout silhouettes, water edges.
